The '''[[1951 in association football|1951]]–[[1952 in association football|52]] season''' was the 53rd completed season of [[The Football League]].

==Final league tables==

The tables below are reproduced here in the exact form that they can be found at [https://www.rsssf.org/engpaul/FLA/1951-52.html The Rec.Sport.Soccer Statistics Foundation] website<ref name="rsssf">{{cite web |url=https://www.rsssf.org/engpaul/FLA/1951-52.html |title=England 1951-52 |publisher=Rec.Sport.Soccer Statistics Foundation|access-date=2010-02-24}}</ref> and in ''Rothmans Book of Football League Records 1888–89 to 1978–79'',<ref name=" Rothmans"/> with home and away statistics separated.

Beginning with the 1894-95 season, clubs finishing level on points were separated according to goal average (goals scored divided by goals conceded), specifically, goals scored divided by goals conceded. Because this metric favoured teams that score fewer goals when goal differences were identical, the goal average system was eventually replaced ahead of the 1976-77 season.  

From the 1922–23 season, the bottom two teams of both Third Division North and Third Division South were required to apply for [[re-election (Football League)|re-election]].<ref name="Rothmans">Ian Laschke: ''Rothmans Book of Football League Records 1888–89 to 1978–79''. Macdonald and Jane’s, London & Sydney, 1980.</ref>

After the title disappointments of the previous five seasons, [[Manchester United F.C.|Manchester United]] finally ended their 41-year wait for the First Division title, finishing four points ahead of their nearest rivals, [[Tottenham Hotspur F.C.|Tottenham Hotspur]] and [[Arsenal F.C.|Arsenal]]. 

[[Huddersfield Town]] and [[Fulham F.C.|Fulham]] were relegated to the Second Division.

{{Infobox football league season

| relegated          = [[Coventry City F.C.|Coventry City]]<br />[[Queens Park Rangers]]

[[Sheffield Wednesday]] were champions of the Second Division scoring exactly 100 goals in the process. After a weak start winning only three of their first eleven matches and losing 7-3 to rivals [[Sheffield United]] in September, the team found their feet and lost only one of their fourteen last matches.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.11v11.com/teams/sheffield-wednesday/tab/matches/season/1952/ |title=Sheffield Wednesday football club match record: 1952 |publisher=11v11.com }}</ref> [[Cardiff City]] finished second on equal points with [[Birmingham City]] and were promoted thanks to a better goal average.
